tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rdo rje phur pa yang gsang spu gri 'bar ba'i las byang khyer bde snying por dril ba kun bzang bde lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru shrī badzra ku mā ra ya/ rgyal kun phrin las 'dus pa'i dpyid// bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la// btud nas yang gsang spu gri yi// las byang 'jug bde'i khrigs su sdeb// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pas rdo rje phur pa sgrub pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ dang po/ dam tshig gi rten rnams tshogs par byas nas/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa yis: lhun grub phyag rgya chen po'i rigs 'dzin dang: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: phrin las brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i gzhas yas na: pho bdud dregs pa brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dpa' bo'i sku: bdud 'dul khro bcu khra thabs 'khor gyis bskor: rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: zhes gsol 'debs dang*/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas mtshams gcad pa ni/ hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed// rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni// sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa// stobs chen khro bo chen po yis// klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos/ /steng yang phur bu'i bla bre la// phur bu'i thog chen char ltar 'beb// 'og kyang phur bu'i sa gzhi la// phur bu'i 'du 'phro me ltar 'bar// phyogs mtshams phur bus gtams pa la// phur bu'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phur bu'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya gardza ha na da ha pa tsa bhandha hu lu tiṣṭha tshindha bhindha spho ṭa ya gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bshags pa ni/ bla ma rig 'dzin rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs la/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro dgongs// theg mchog mnyam pa'i don nyid ma rtogs pas// bde gshegs bka' dang 'gal spyad nongs pa kun// gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags tshangs par gsol//

spro na spyi bshags ye shes sku mchog kyang bya'o// de nas/ oṃ badzra pra be sha ya phaṭa kyis brda' sgo dbye/ a ti pū hoḥ pra titstsha hoḥ sa brda' phyag 'tshal/ oṃ bo dhi tsitta sa ma ya st+waṃ gyis dam bca' 'o// byin dbab pa ni/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag gnas yo byad la thim par bsam la/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir// gnyis med dag pa'i mkha' dbyings nas// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur cig /byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig /mthu chen rnams kyis mthu stsol cig /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya de ba ga ṇa a dhiṣṭhā na ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes dbab/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ hūm̐/ rtog bral ye shes bdud rtsi 'bar// chags med rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil// 'dod yon lnga yi gtor chen spungs// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kha ta li bhrūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlab bo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ rdo rje khros pas zhe snang gcod// mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba yis// nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs pa shar// zhes ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis khog phub nas/ hūm̐/ e yaṃ raṃ suṃ keṃ raṃ bhrūm̐/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe ratna bhañdza e maṇḍa la bhrūm̐/ hūm̐/ rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*// gru gsum mthing nag zla gam rin chen 'bar// gru chad bar khyams sgo bzhi mu khyud rdzogs// ngo mtshar pho brang ye shes me 'od gsal// badzra ta taṃ/ ru dra kro dhī ti ra baṃ/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍa la/ paṃ padma maṇḍa la/

hūm̐/ rdo rje brag chen gtams pa'i sa gzhi la// dregs pa lha chen phyogs skyong pho mo bsnol// thabs shes nyi ma zla ba 'od 'bar dbus// ma chags padma 'bar ba'i gdan du bsam// hūm̐/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyang tshul// bzhad pa'i zhal g.yas dkar zhing g.yon dmar gshe /dbus zhal mthing nag drag tu rngam zhing 'bar// spyan dgu sdang mig khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug /shangs nas hūm̐ 'byin zhal nas phaṭa sgra sgrog /rno dbal drag po'i mche ba zur gsum gtsigs// nyi khri chig stong dbu skra gyen du 'khyil// bye ba ther 'bum rdo rje'i ba spus gtams// g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs// g.yon gyi dang pos me dpung 'bar ba bsnams// g.yas kyi gnyis pas rdo rje rtse lnga 'phyar/ kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum g.yon gyi gnyis par 'khrol// tha ma'i phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril// rigs lnga'i rtse bran thod skam cod pan can// tshar gsum thod pa'i phreng ba ga shal bsnams// sbrul chen rigs bzhi phud sgra sgrog pas brgyan// rakta'i thig le zhag gi zo ris dang*// thal chen tshom bus rab brjid glang chen gyi// ko rlon zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gos su gyon// stag lpags sham thabs 'phyang zhing rdo rje yi// gshog pa gdengs pas bar snang khyab par 'gengs// mthing nag dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba'i sku /rdo rje khro bo nyams dgus rol pa'i yum// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing ga khro zhing sgeg /g.yas pa utpal 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// g.yon pas bhan dmar stob la rab brtson ma/ khro mo'i rgyan dang gzig lpags sham thabs can// bde stong sbyor bas 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// yab kyi thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad pa// margad gur phub lta bu'i srog gi gor// ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems tshon gang ba// dkar gsal rdor dril rin chen rgyan cha can// de yi thugs kar rin chen cha brgyad dbus// sran ma bkas pa tsam gyi nyi ma la// rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐// yungs 'bru tsam du phra zhing 'bar ba'i mthar// srog yig 'bru dgus g.yas su bskor ba'i sgo

/rta mgrin dmar po padma bhañdza'i phyag /yum dang gnyis med 'khril bas bsrung bar gyur// hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku /ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig /srog gi go ru shar ba dang*// snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya// hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng phyogs nyi zla bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// hūm̐ chen sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar phyogs dri za bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rnam rgyal snyems ma stag dang bya rgod mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha nī la daṇḍa hūm̐/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho me lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ya mānta ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho phyogs gshin rje bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la hūm̐/ bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub srin po bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub phyogs klu dbang bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang rlung lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// 'dod rgyal mda' snyems spyang ki khra yi mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐/ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// bdud rtsi rlung 'byin seṅge pha waṃ mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐/

bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar dbang ldan bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ khams gsum gsod ma dom dang sre mang mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og phyogs sa bdag bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// stobs chen bskyod ma dred dang byi ba'i mgo /oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha kro dhī shwa rī/ ma tha ma tha badzra/ dzwa la dzwa la badzra/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgrog srid gsum 'khor ba 'jig /bdud 'dul mthu chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu// za byed gsod byed gtum rngams tshogs bcas gsal// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kro dha kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zla gam e yi gdan steng du// srid gsum gdug pa sgrol mdzad pa'i// dpal chen sku gsung thugs kyi sras// mthu chen nyi shu rtsa gcig gsal// hūm̐/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas// rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ mo ha ghā ta ya ma ma shrī ghraṃ karma ka ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi ru// las bzhi sgrub mdzad sgo ma bzhi// bar khyams phur srung bcu gnyis dang*// bse lcags dung sogs ging chen bzhi// phyi yi 'khor yug lcags ri la// mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// ma bdun sring bzhi dbang phyug sogs// dam can 'khor yug gang bar gyur// ces rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam gsum yongs rdzogs bkrag gsal du bskyed do// de nas rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i 'od zer rang bzhin rdo rje phur bu'i zhing khams thams cad du khyab par 'phros pas srid pa'i phur bu gzugs kyi sku gang la gang 'dul gyi mos pa dang 'tsham par sad par gyur/

oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dgongs gsol brjod nas/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor 'di la dgongs// oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya e hye hi bha ga wān sa ma ya dza dzaḥ sa ye shes pa spyan drangs te mdun mkhar bzhugs pa la/ a ti pū hoḥ pra titstsha hoḥ sa phyag 'tshal/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ swā āṃḥhā/ kā ya wā ka tsitta gu ṇa karma siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gis dbang blang*/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha st+waṃ gyis dam tshig pa la gnyis med du bstim mo// de nas mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon drag po'i rdzas// sman gtor rakta dug gsum sha khrag rus// rmad byung sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod sprin spro// dpal chen dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar dang ma hā pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba lingta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha kha raṃ khā hi ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu mchog /skye med rnam dag 'khor lo rgyal 'debs yum// sa bcu'i mnga' bdag khro rgyal yab yum bcu// nyon mongs sgrol mdzad khra thabs nyi shu'i tshogs// sku gsung thugs sprul sras mchog nyi shu gcig /bar chad srung mdzad sgo skyong phur srung sogs// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas dzap bzla ba ni/ 1$0000270dkyil 'khor gsum spyi dang khyad par bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin 1$0000300

pa sku phyag rgya la dmigs pa/ 1$0000270thugs srog sngags 'khor las 'od zer 'phro 'dus kyis don gnyis byas par mos 1$0000300 pa gsung yig 'bru la dmigs pa/ 1$0000270sems nyid skye med kyi ngang du rig pa 'dzin med tshogs drug lhug par 'jog 1$0000300 pa thugs chos nyid la dmigs pa/ dzap khang phyes te 1$0000270bdag mdun gyi thugs ka dang lte ba nas sngags phreng mgal me ltar 'khor bar dmigs 1$0000300 pa yon tan dbang dang dngos grub len pa/ 1$0000270sngags kyi 'od zer ljang nag khro mtshon phur thun gyi char babs pas dgra bgegs kyi sgo gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa phye mar brlag cing tshe bsod rang la bsdu 1$0000300 ba phrin las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dmigs pa bcas dzap dgongs lnga las/ bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs 'dir gtso bor sku gsung thugs kyi dzap dgongs la gzhi bca' 'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ zhes srog sngags 'bru dgu /las sngags 'bru lnga/ 'phyong sngags 'bru gsum bcas sbrel ba yi ge bcu bdun pa ni bsnyen pa'i sngags te/ grangs kyi tshad ni bdun 'bum nyis khrir gsungs so// bsnyen sgrub chig chod la bsnyen sngags mthar/ ma rag mo yag mo: kā la rū pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: srog la yaṃ yaṃ: snying la phril phril: srog la chum chum: tsitta srog la tung tung: snying khrag srog la shad shad: thum ri li li: tseg tseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: gul gul: myags myags: sod sod: ḍā ki ma ma karma: shrī ghraṃ ka ra ye: mā ra se na: pra mārdha na ye hūm̐ phaṭa: ces drag sngags 'dus pa yi ge bdun cu rtsa drug pa nyid sbrel te bzla'o// thun mthar stong tshigs kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dpal chen phur pa'i lha tshogs gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod// bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dngos grub stsol//

ces dngos grub blang ngo*// gsum pa rjes la tshogs mchod 'bul bar spro na/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus nas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong rin po che'i snod du tshogs rdzas rnams rigs lnga yab yum gyi dam tshig chen po'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gyi rnam pa cir yang 'char bar bsam zhing oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes brlabs/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa la// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

de nas tshogs phud cha gsum du bcad de/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ badzra yakṣa kro dha khā hi/ spro na skong ba'i las rim gsum yang bya'o// bar pa bshags pa ni/ ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang// de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams// mi yi skyon mthong tsam na bar chad rtsom// bdag cag ma rig sgo gsum bag med pas// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs byas bshags// tshogs kyis mchod do tshangs dbang dngos grub stsol// sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha st+waṃ/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ rgyas par gab pa'i sngags drug spu gri'i dgongs pa ltar bsgral ba las gzhung bzhin shes par bya la/ 'dir tshogs mchod dkyus tsam du/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs gnod byed dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shī ghraṃ ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dmigs bya dgug la/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab// phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab: shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab: bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab: sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab: khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab: mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab// ces pho nya bskul/ hūm̐/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni// gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// yud tsam gyis ni 'dir bkug nas// mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*// lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang*// sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod// oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+wambha ya nān/ mo hā gha ta ya/ bha ga wān/ hrīḥṣṭiḥbi krita shrī badzra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/

badzra kī li kī la ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bighnān/ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ a phaṭa/ ces bzla bzhin gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas tshe khrus sbar gsum gyi dgongs pas brten pa dbyings su bsgral/ rten gzhi bag chags snyigs ma'i lus bdud rtsir sbar la/ hūm̐/ dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig /dgra bgegs lnga phung zhal du stob// sdang dgra gdon bgegs 'khor bcas rnams// rdul phran tsam yang med par rol// badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bstabs/ skabs 'dir spro na bcol bskul yang bya'o// de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lhag ma'i dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung por gyur/ ces brlabs/ e a ralli hriṃ dzaḥ sa lhag mgron spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab// sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas pa'i// mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod// lhag ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bstan pa gnyan po srung du gsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā ba lingta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ buddha ḍā ki nī/ badzra ḍā ki nī/ ratna ḍā ki nī/ padma ḍā ki nī/ karma sarba ḍā ki nī kha kha khā hi khā hi/ kiṃ ka ra ma hā pañtsa ba lingta khā hi/ zhes phyi rol du dor ro// de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo/ chos nyid kyi bden pa 'o// gsang sngags kyi byin gyi brlab bo// sangs rgyas kyi mthu 'o// a bhi tsarya'i dus la bab bo// brnag pa de kho na la 'o// de ltar gsang sngags kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba spyad pa'i mthu byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la longs spyod cing skal pa mnyam par gyur cig

/ bzod par gsol ba ni/ hoḥ dpal chen po'i lha tshogs thams cad dgongs su gsol/ ta na sgrol ba gnas su ma stob pa dang*/ ga ṇa sbyor ba byin gyis ma rlob pa dang*/ mchod sngags ting 'dzin ma dag cing nyams pa dang*/ dge ba bcu dang du ma longs shing mi dge ba bcu rtsad nas ma chod pa dang*/ bka' bzhin gzhung ma bsrangs pa dang*/ dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag nyams chag tu gyur pa ci mchis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags na bzod par mdzad du gsol/ tshe 'di'i rkyen dang phyi ma'i sgrib par mi 'gyur bar tshangs pa dam pa stsol ba ci gnang*/ zhes gsol zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod/ gtor ma gtong na/ bstan ma'i gtor ma phyir bsnur la sman raka sbreng zhing*/ hūm̐/ bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas// dam las ma 'da' da tshur byon// bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces bskul la gtong*/ spro na zor bskul yang bya'o// de nas bro brdung ba ni/ gtor gzhong ri rab gsal ba'i 'og tu dam sri mnan par bsam la/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+wambha ya nan/ ya ma dam sri nā ga rā tsa dzaḥnan/ zhes mnan/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis 'od gsal du bsdus te rtag mtha' bsal/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lhar ldangs pas chad mtha' bsal te zung 'jug gi ting 'dzin chu bo'i rgyun lta bu la sbyar ro// 'dis kyang bdag gzhan skye kun tu// lha mchog khyod dang mi 'bral zhing*// thal 'byin dgongs pa mthar phyin nas// he ru kaḥdapal 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'ang rang gzhan gyi rgyun gyi nyams len dang*/ sgrub pa chen po'i skabs dzap bsnyen pa sogs kyis las gzhung mdor bsdus su khyer bde ba'i slad du nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar nas/ 7kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal gyi bka' drin las phur pa bka' gter gsar rnying yongs rdzogs kyi smin grol gyi snod du gyur cing*/

khyad par lam 'di nyid la snga rjes bsnyen sgrub lan mang thems pa'i btsun pa rdo rje dbang mchog phrin las 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa ste/ 'dis kyang skye kun rdo rje gzhon nus rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig// / ༈ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang sems can kun// bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun zhi zhing*// rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa'i sar// 'bras bu byang chub nges par brnyes gyur cig / bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las// thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa// bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku// mi 'gyur rtag pa'i don gyi bkra shis shog /'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum gyi bkra shis shog /sprul pa'i khro rgyal bcu yi bkra shis shog /shes rab khro mo bcu yi bkra shis shog /yang sprul phyag brnyan tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /sras mchog phur pa'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /ye shes sgo skyong bzhi yi bkra shis shog /dam can bka' sdod srung ma'i bkra shis shog /dge legs 'bras bu smin pa'i bkra shis shog / sogs bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod par bya'o/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
